description: Shows a saved Lightbringer report in the report view: the title and each section of the saved report, open or collapsed as the saved report sets them. Takes the report:<id> of a saved report from search, fetch or the outputs of a completed Lightbringer task, both for a new report and to reopen an earlier one. Returns the complete saved text and the report link with the view. Read-only: it does not search for prior art, generate, edit, save or publish a report, request attorney review or take payment. The saved wording, citations and limits stay unchanged. Attorney approval, source completeness and independent checks are not verified by this read. Where the host does not show the view, the returned text and link are the text version of the report.
name: show_report
title: Lightbringer report
